map.平面度 = 最高测点 − 最低测点（最小区域法近似）。: Flatness = highest measured point - lowest measured point (minimum zone approximation).
map.平面度 = 最高点 - 最低点（最小包容面）。例：测 9 点极差 0.008 m: Flatness = highest point - lowest point (minimum containing plane). Example: 9 measured points with a range of 0.008 mm give flatness 0.008 mm.
map.最高点 0.018 mm，最低点 −0.012 mm: Highest point 0.018 mm, lowest point -0.012 mm
map.平面度=0.018−(−0.012)=0.030 mm，即 30.0 μm。这是: Flatness = 0.018 - (-0.012) = 0.030 mm, i.e. 30.0 μm. This is the minimum-zone approximation; the more points measured, the closer it gets to the true flatness.
map.平面度是单一面的形状误差，平行度约束两平面关系。: Flatness is the form error of a single surface, while parallelism constrains the relation between two planes.
map.三点定基准平面，取其余点偏离最大差。: Three points define the datum plane, then take the largest deviation among the remaining points.
map.平面度误差 = 最高点 − 最低点（mm）；联动卡：μm 口径 × 1000、中: Flatness error = highest point − lowest point (mm); linked cards: μm basis ×1000, median height = (highest + lowest) ÷ 2, relative flatness = (highest−lowest) ÷ (median height||1) × 10⁶ (ppm). Validation: no strict validation; empty values count as 0, and a median height of 0 falls back to 1. Criteria: no fixed grading; the smaller the error the flatter the surface.
